hypothesis: Using the minimum energy of training solutions as the stopping threshold matches the symbolic validity-gate accuracy within5pp while wrong halts remain below1percent of halted puzzles, on independent dev2560:4608.
control: Contemporaneous energy_max and energy_AND_valid onsamehost/cohort; energy_p05 is secondary.
validity_gate: Zero equal-digit conflicts across the810unordered row/column/box-neighbor pairs; clues remain clamped. No target labels used by gate or move policy.
primary_statistic: Accuracy(min)-accuracy(validitygate), and pooled wronghalts/min halted puzzles. Threshold uses training solutions only.
uncertainty: 5000pairedtwo-wayseed/puzzlebootstrap, sixseedclusters,2048puzzles, seed20261114. Boundaryzeroerrors additionally reportconservative per-puzzle event bound, repeatedseedsnot independent.
decision: Supported iff one-sided95percent lower accuracydifference>=-5pp and upperwronghaltrate<=1percent. Falsified iff upperaccuracydifference<-5pp or lowerwronghaltrate>1percent; otherwiseinconclusive.
mechanistic_statistic: Fraction of original wrong-stop puzzles newly solved at same cap; report changes on other puzzles too.
budget_and_cost: Same move cap, not equal realized compute. Added rule-check operations and elapsed time retained; legacy FLOPs exclude gate and cannot establish net arithmetic speedup.
rng_limit: Same initialseed and move keys before diverging stops/compaction; thereafter paths may diverge.
scope: Task-rule validity checker is additional symbolic knowledge; not an unmodified pure CRAM reproduction, not an exact external solver.
